There is no separate agent repeating the same analysis for a different purpose.

All relevant information in [M1] is used in [M2]. In particular, the note that the 15% discount applies to price, not weight, is explicitly addressed, and the weight calculation is carried through to the final trip count. There is no visible ignored or contradicted evidence.
